text.p: Average yields at auctions of three- and six-month treasury bills rose from the last sale on March 18, and the auction of 9-month and 12-month bills was cancelled, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Three-month bills edged up to 24.47 percent from 24.24 percent, and six-month bills firmed to 30.18 percent from 30.07 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 103 99
Issue date March 19, 1997 March 18, 1997
Maturity date June 18, 1997 June 17, 1997
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia (UAH)
Issue volume 3.50 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.15 million UAH 2.89 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.96 million UAH 2.73 million UAH
Average yield 24.47 percent 24.24 percent
Average price 94.25 hryvnia 94.30 hryvnia
Cut-off price 94.25 hryvnia 94.30 hryvnia
The central bank sold 31,464 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 29,830 were competitive and 1,634 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 20.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 104 100
Issue date March 19, 1997 March 18, 1997
Maturity date September 17, 1997 September 16, 1997
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume 5.50 million UAH 9.80 million UAH
Amount sold 2.72 million UAH 4.60 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.36 million UAH 4.00 million UAH
Average yield 30.18 percent 30.07 percent
Average price 86.92 hryvnia 86.96 hryvnia
Cut-off price 86.92 hryvnia 86.92 hryvnia
The central bank sold 27,201 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,881 were competitive and 25,320 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 20.
Nine-month and 12-month T-bill auctions were cancelled without explanation.
